summary: Simplified the Rerun camera entity logging so spear/camera carries only the transform, pinhole, and RGB image. Depth, normals, and albedo now log under separate spear/images paths, preventing non-RGB planes from appearing as camera children in the 3D view.

Moved depth_meters from spear/camera/depth_meters to spear/images/depth_meters.
Moved world_normal from spear/camera/world_normal to spear/images/world_normal.
Moved diffuse_color/albedo from spear/camera/diffuse_color to spear/images/albedo.
Left camera position, trajectory, light direction, and light status on their existing 3D-friendly spear paths.
README wording did not require an update.

findings.message: Verification passed: stubbed log_rerun_frame smoke check confirmed expected paths and absence of spear/camera depth, normal, diffuse_color, or albedo children. The current Python environment lacks numpy, so the smoke check stubbed numpy, spear, and Rerun.
